name: Arizona Corporation Commission Project Baccara CEC Decision Summary
known_limitations: The Commission summary proves the CEC vote and records the proposed project configuration. It does not approve the data center itself, prove construction or operation, replace the full docket and order, or verify the developer's future cooling, wastewater-reuse, groundwater, cost, air-permit, county-permit, or military-compatibility outcomes.
automation_notes: Search docket L-21369A-25-0222-00253 and later ADEQ, Maricopa County, Luke Air Force Base, military-compatibility, construction, air-quality, water, and operating records. Keep proposed configuration separate from built performance.
notes: Phase 55B named facility record. The ACC says it voted unanimously on February 4, 2026 to approve a CEC for approximately 700 MW of proposed on-site natural-gas generation serving Project Baccara. The ACC also records developer statements about chilled cooling and wastewater reuse while stating that county and Luke Air Force Base approvals remained pending.
